record_type_quote: In a replication study we largely reproduce finding (1), but we fail to confirm finding (2).

targets.title: Principal-agent settings with random shocks.
targets.evidence_quote: In our replication study, we implement the same three treatments as RS16: In the “No-Shock” treatment, the worker’s effort is not distorted by a shock.
targets.outcome_quote: We have reproduced RS16’s finding that the introduction of shocks reduces efforts when shocks are unobserved. However, we failed to confirm the result that observable shocks have the same impact on behavior as unobservable shocks.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly confirm one central finding and reject the other.

reasoning: New laboratory sample re-tests the three treatments of Rubin and Sheremeta (2016). Original-data comparisons are ancillary to the new-data replication.
